versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes in this release.
- Version update only; no file or documentation changes detected.

- No user-visible changes in this release.
- Version bumped from 0.1.0 to 0.1.1 for maintenance or internal reasons.

- Initial release of the crypto-market-data skill.
- Fetch realtime spot prices and full historical price/K-line data for any cryptocurrency symbol or coin ID.
- Supports Binance and CoinGecko as data sources for both realtime and historical data.
- Provides clear commands for fetching market data via Node scripts or importing in projects.
- Includes guidance on when to use each data source and output format (JSON).
- Outputs structured results with query details, realtime data, history, and non-fatal errors.
